ns2:course.label: Chronic Disease Prevention
ns2:course.description: Advanced course in population-based approaches to chronic disease prevention, with emphasis on policy and environmental strategies affecting lifestyle risk factors. Provides an understanding of common diseases, screen tests, community assessment, systematic evidence reviews, and evidence-based community interventions. Prerequisite: MPH students or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MPH students or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Community Health or Public Health major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
